evidence: Changes src/headerssync.cpp and src/net_processing.cpp to dynamically compute headers presync DoS protection parameters at runtime.
rationale: Dynamically derives DoS-protection parameters for headers presync while fixing an attack model flaw where attackers strategically stop mid-batch. As noted in the description, the PR reduces maintainer release burden and eliminates manual guessing of software lifetimes while tightening the DoS model.
